description:
We're delighted to share that today we organised a Dental Camp for the students of Aryan Education Society High School, Charni Road — benefiting 150 students!

This wouldn't have been possible without Dr. Shohib Akai, who generously brought his team of doctors and medical staff to conduct the camp. We are truly grateful to him for taking time out of his busy professional schedule to support this initiative.

Joining me for this wonderful project were fellow Rotarians — Rtn. Fatim, Rtn. Meenaa and Jay Rtn. Pallavee, and Rtn. Devam.
